name: Vinoteket
why_curated: Holding our single permitted craft pizza quota spot, Vinoteket redefines pizza as fine gastronomy. Its celebrated tasting menu pairs hyper-light, long-fermented sourdough slices with scallops, chanterelles, and an award-winning international wine cellar.

dish_highlights.review_text: High-hydration slow-fermented sourdough base with blistered micro-bubbles, topped with Norwegian hand-dived scallops and sea salt.

name: Mint on Wheels
why_curated: Dedicated artisanal mobile matcha cart bringing single-origin ceremonial green tea from Kyoto straight to Oslo neighborhood squares.
notes: Next Drop: Thu Nov 14 at 12:00 at Mike's Corner (Operagata 77d, Bjørvika). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mintonwheels/

dish_highlights.review_text: Authentic ceremonial matcha imported directly from Uji, Kyoto, hand-whisked to order on a mobile cart.

name: U WAN' SAM?
why_curated: U WAN SUM is an itinerant specialty beverage pop-up known for hosting limited-edition weekend takeovers across Oslo creative spaces and coffee bars. Their concept reimagines classic Southeast Asian café culture through artisanal Vietnamese iced coffees, layered matcha infusions, and velvety foam toppings. Operating without a permanent storefront, their drops attract devoted queues of design-conscious locals tracking their announcements on Instagram.
notes: Drop schedule: Weekend specialty Vietnamese coffee drops. Instagram: https://instagram.com/uwansamofficial

dish_highlights.review_text: Dark, bittersweet Vietnamese robusta drip crowned with an impossibly thick, velvety custard foam whipped from egg yolks and sweetened condensed milk.

name: Sukkerbakeriet
why_curated: Ultra-popular Fredrikstad artisan bakery doing exclusive weekend flash drops and pop-up takeovers in Oslo.
notes: Drop schedule: Monthly weekend drops with pre-orders and on-site boxes. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sukkerbakeriet/

dish_highlights.review_text: Decadent deep-dish cookie studded with premium Belgian chocolate and coarse Maldon sea salt.

name: Crantz Cookies
why_curated: Sister-duo viral NYC-style chunky cookie sensation expanding from pop-up takeovers toward permanent retail.
notes: Drop schedule: Weekly bakery batches and retail supply drops. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/crantzcookies/

dish_highlights.review_text: Classic New York-style chunky cookie with caramelized edges, melted milk chocolate pools, and a soft center.
Thick spiced dough packed with white chocolate chunks and molten Lotus Biscoff speculoos core.

name: Tomodomo
why_curated: Sensational Japanese noodle and dessert residency at Trekanten drawing massive lines for handmade noodles and viral desserts.
notes: Drop schedule: Weekly continuous service Wednesday through Sunday at Trekanten. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tomodomo_oslo/

dish_highlights.review_text: Deep, savory fermented miso broth with house-kneaded ramen noodles, roasted bamboo shoots, and tender pork.
Handmade thick Sanuki-style udon noodles coated in rich chili sesame tare and scallions.
Pan-fried Japanese dumplings with a golden crispy skirt and succulent minced filling.

name: DÆSJ Gelatobar
why_curated: Experimental artisan gelato bar concept by Warunee Bolstad with curated sommelier natural wine pairings.
notes: Drop schedule: Seasonal 10-day popup residencies at Vulkan 9 / Mathallen. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/daesj_gelato/

dish_highlights.review_text: Thai sweet sticky rice infused gelato topped with fresh mango coulis and crispy roasted mung beans.
Rich velvety cream gelato drizzled with aromatic spicy chili crisp oil and crunchy cacao nibs.

name: Anniken Bævre Cookie Pop-up
why_curated: Beloved Oslo cookie artist holding high-energy pop-up events at Vulkan selling warm scoopable cookies and edible cookie dough.
notes: Drop schedule: Monthly weekend drops via Instagram announcements at Vulkan Oslo. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/annikenbaevre/

dish_highlights.review_text: Fresh-baked molten chocolate chip cookie served warm in a bowl with cold vanilla ice cream.
Pasteurized safe-to-eat gourmet cookie dough made with brown butter and French sea salt.

name: WAAJ Taqueria
why_curated: Vippa container street food stall crafting authentic Guatemalan and Mexican heirloom masa corn tacos.
notes: Drop schedule: Open Wednesday through Sunday year-round at Vippa. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/waaj_taqueria/

dish_highlights.review_text: Authentic citrus-confit slow-braised pork served on fresh heirloom corn tortillas with pickled red onions and habanero salsa.
Toasted nixtamalized corn tortilla packed with bubbling Oaxaca-style cheese and avocado salsa.

name: Aleppo Bahebek
why_curated: Iconic Syrian refugee-founded street kitchen bringing the deeply spiced traditions of historic Aleppo to Oslo harbor.
notes: Drop schedule: Open Wednesday through Sunday year-round at Vippa. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aleppobahebek/

dish_highlights.review_text: Warm saj flatbread rolled with marinated spit-roasted chicken, tangy cucumber pickles, and garlic toum.

dish_highlights.dish_name: Smaken av Aleppo med kylling shawarma
dish_highlights.review_text: Grand tasting feast platter featuring chicken shawarma, silken hummus, smoky mutabbal eggplant, tabbouleh, and fresh bread.
Traditional Levantine platter of toasted sliced shawarma roll portions served with crispy fries and garlic dip.

name: Ole Martin Sandness Pizza Pop-up at Mike's Corner
why_curated: High-craft guest pizza pop-up series hosted at Mike's Corner waterfront bodega in Oslobukta by pizzaiolo Ole Martin Sandness.
notes: Drop schedule: Recurring weekend pop-up series (~100 pizza batches per event; walk-in queue). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mikescorneroslo/

dish_highlights.review_text: One-night signature creation blending Mike's Corner bodega ingredients with high-hydration fermented pizza dough.
Blistered wood-fired pie loaded with spicy artisanal Italian salami, crushed tomatoes, and melted mozzarella.

name: Bånkall Gård Pop-up Dinners
signature_dish: Grillet Mont d'Or med stekt brød, honning og småpoteter
why_curated: Atmospheric historic farm in outer Oslo hosting intimate seasonal comfort dinners (melted Mont d'Or, French onion soup, farm sourdough).
notes: Drop schedule: Specific Thursday evening supper clubs with advance table bookings. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bankall_gard/

dish_highlights.dish_name: Grillet Mont d'Or med stekt brød, honning og småpoteter
dish_highlights.review_text: Whole box-baked French Mont d'Or cheese bubbling with garlic and white wine, served with roasted potatoes and toast.
Rich caramelized French onion soup simmered in savory beef bone broth and baked under a golden Gruyère sourdough crust.

name: Hrimnir Ramen
why_curated: Nordic fermentation meets Japanese ramen craft. Hrimnir makes its own noodles from scratch, ferments miso from local grains, and finishes toppings over glowing charcoal.
notes: Google Place pin updated from 59.9209/10.7519 to 59.9213763/10.7514386. Note: 270 kr is slightly above CURATION.md 260 kr sweet-spot ceiling; live website omits individual prices.

dish_highlights.review_text: Slow-simmered chicken paitan broth with house-fermented spicy miso, smoky pork belly chashu, coffee-cured egg, charred cabbage, pickled daikon, and handmade noodles.
Slow-simmered Norwegian chicken broth seasoned with house-fermented shoyu, handmade noodles, and soft egg.
Steamed fluffy bao bun filled with grilled Nordic mushrooms and savory glaze.

name: Sapporo Ramen Bar
why_curated: Hokkaido-style counter-service ramen stall on the edge of Vulkan with short evening hours, steaming rich broth bowls, crispy gyoza, and drop-in seating only.
opening_hours_text: Mon: Closed, Tue-Fri: 15:00-19:30, Sat: 13:00-19:00, Sun: Closed (drop-in only)
notes: Google Place pin updated from 59.9229/10.7519 to 59.9233329/10.7514626. Menu lists Miso and Spicy separately; live pricing sits in QR ordering (confirm 195 kr vs earlier 215 kr draft).

dish_highlights.review_text: Steaming Hokkaido-style rich miso broth with chili heat, tender sliced pork chashu, soft-boiled ajitama egg, spring scallions, and springy ramen noodles.
Soy sauce Hokkaido broth served with tender svineribbe, lava egg, bamboo shoots, and spring onions.
Pan-seared Japanese pork dumplings with crisp golden bottoms and house dipping tare.

name: Daglig Brød
why_curated: Perched in historic Gamlebyen near the medieval park ruins, Daglig Brød is an artisanal neighborhood bakery that champions organic Norwegian heritage grains and wild sourdough leavening. Loaves emerge with dark, blistered crusts and custardy crumb structures alongside hand-twisted sweet buns baked fresh each morning. The warm, flour-dusted storefront draws locals across eastern Oslo for morning coffee and still-warm pastries.

dish_highlights.review_text: Plump, golden hand-twisted dough infused with coarsely crushed cardamom pods and real butter, caramelized lightly on the baking stone.
Soft bakery cardamom bun baked daily in Gamlebyen with freshly ground spice.
Crisp golden pastry wrapped around melted dark chocolate batons.

name: Yum Cha
why_curated: Located in the quiet streets behind Majorstuen, Yum Cha revives traditional Cantonese dim sum culture with retro 1970s Hong Kong tea house flair. Bamboo steamers arrive stacked at the table filled with translucent prawn dumplings, open-topped pork siu mai, and barbecue pork buns made by hand. It provides Oslo diners an authentic weekend brunch ritual steeped in jasmine tea and savory dim sum baskets.

dish_highlights.review_text: Delicate translucent steamed wheat-starch skins stuffed with sweet, plump whole tiger prawns and crunchy water chestnuts, bursting with savory steam.
Deep fried dumplings made with mashed taro stuffed with chicken curry.
Fried chicken with crispy garlic. Served with rice.

name: Miso Ramen
why_curated: Located near Vika and Aker Brygge, Miso Ramen specializes in authentic northern Japanese noodle bowls centered on deep, fermented miso broths and slow-cooked paitan. Each bowl is assembled with house-made wavy alkaline noodles engineered to hold maximum soup, crowned with torch-seared chashu pork, marinated eggs, and menma bamboo shoots. The steamy, high-energy dining room offers some of the city's most comforting winter slurping.

dish_highlights.review_text: Springy wavy noodles swimming in a rich, wok-tossed pork bone broth deepened with roasted fermented red miso, charred sweetcorn, and tender rolled pork belly.
Traditional Japanese soy broth topped with braised chashu pork, soft egg, corn, and nori.
Double-fried ginger-garlic Japanese chicken bites served crisp with Kewpie mayo.

name: Masala Politics
why_curated: Facing the buzz of Karl Johans gate, Masala Politics brings theatrical pan-Indian street kitchen vibrancy to central Oslo. The dynamic dining room pairs retro Bollywood posters with clay tandoor ovens churning out blistered naan, smoky kebabs, and slow-simmered regional curries. Its lively pace, creative cocktail pairings, and uncompromised spice levels draw both late-night city revelers and discerning spice fans.

dish_highlights.review_text: Tender chargrilled chicken breast morsels smothered in an opulent, velvety gravy made from ground cashews, green cardamom, and saffron-infused cream.
Signature Peshawari Naan prepared fresh at Masala Politics.

name: Fuglen Coffee Roasters
why_curated: Housed in a spacious former 19th-century grain silo and factory in Gamlebyen, Fuglen's roasting headquarters represents the pinnacle of Nordic light-roast philosophy. The vintage mid-century modern interior showcases vintage Scandinavian design furniture while beans are meticulously roasted on a restored cast-iron machine. It is a world-renowned pilgrimage site for coffee connoisseurs seeking floral, tea-like single origins and bean-to-bar drinking chocolates.

dish_highlights.review_text: Silky melted single-origin 70% dark chocolate steamed with fresh Norwegian organic milk, revealing deep notes of roasted dried cherries and raw cocoa.
Light Nordic single-origin pour-over highlighting bright floral and berry acidity.
Silky steamed milk poured over Fuglen's signature light-roasted Oslo espresso.

name: Crave
why_curated: A short train hop from Oslo Central Station in Lillestrøm, Crave specializes in viral Japanese soufflé pancakes and indulgent sweet and savory comfort fare. Their griddle chefs whip egg whites to stiff peaks, cooking the batter slowly under steam to create jiggly, cloud-like pancakes that melt effortlessly on the tongue. The pastel-toned dessert cafe draws continuous weekend pilgrimages from pastry enthusiasts across the greater Oslo region.

dish_highlights.review_text: Towering, jiggly Japanese soufflé pancakes with an airy, marshmallow-like interior, smothered in molten pistachio sauce and crushed nuts.
En kremet cheesecake med bunn av Biscoff-kjeks og luftig fyll. Toppet med smeltet Biscoff spread og knuste kjeks rundt kanten for en ekstra.
Toppet med kanel-smør-lønnesirup og friske bær. Myke og luftige soufflépannekaker som tilberedes ferske fra bunnen av når du bestiller. Dett.

name: Kveitemjøl
why_curated: Overlooking the harbor promenade at Aker Brygge, Kveitemjøl represents the apex of modern French-Nordic laminating and sourdough viennoiserie in Oslo. Using stone-ground flours and cultured European butter, their bakers fold dozens of paper-thin layers into crisp croissants, cruffins, and glazed swirls. The waterfront bakery frequently forms early morning lines of waterfront joggers and office workers waiting for the next oven bell.

dish_highlights.review_text: Multi-laminated flaky pastry twisted around rich cinnamon-butter paste, crowned with pearl sugar and baked to an audible golden crunch.
Freshly braided sourdough cardamom knot dusted with aromatic crushed pods and sugar.
Twice-baked laminated croissant filled with rich frangipane almond cream and toasted flakes.

name: Stykke - Hasle
why_curated: Anchoring the modern courtyard of Hasle Linje, Stykke brings contemporary Brooklyn-style slice-shop energy to Oslo's inner east. Giant 20-inch round pies and thick square Roman slices are tossed and baked on stone decks, topped with adventurous flavor pairings from hot honey to teriyaki chicken. With counter seating, craft sodas, and grab-and-go convenience, it has become a community clubhouse for the neighborhood.

dish_highlights.review_text: A crisp, thin-crusted New York style pizza slice loaded with charred teriyaki glazed chicken, melted fior di latte, sesame seeds, and fresh spring onions.
Tomatsaus, mozzarella, fior di latte, pecorino romano, parmigiano reggiano, basilikum, ekstra virgin olivenolje.
Kjøttdeig av storfe fra Annis pølsemakeri, mozzarella, fior di latte, cheddar, isbergsalat, spesialdressing og sesamfrø på skorpen.

name: Lai Zai - Viet Street Food
why_curated: Perched on upper Thorvald Meyers gate in Grünerløkka, Lai Zai recreates the electric atmosphere and punchy flavors of Saigon night markets. The kitchen emphasizes scratch-made marinades, fresh herbs flown in weekly, and blistered baguettes loaded with rich liver pâté and house pickles. It has become a neighborhood staple for unpretentious Vietnamese street eats and cold imported beers.

dish_highlights.review_text: Warm, crackling baguette filled with savory roasted meat, rich liver pâté, crisp pickled daikon, and a fiery drizzle of house lemongrass chili oil.
2 pcs. Vietnamese fresh springrolls with scampi, pork, vermicelli noodles, salad, mint, coriander, bean sprouts and homemade cracker. Served.

name: Digg Pizza - Grønland
why_curated: Digg Pizza brings Roman-style pizza al taglio to Grønland, fermenting their airy high-hydration dough for over 48 hours to create a shatteringly crisp, focaccia-like crust. Baked in rectangular blue-steel pans, the vibrant neighborhood counter lets diners mix-and-match square cuts topped with fresh local produce and Italian cured meats. It has become a fast neighborhood favorite for casual street-side lunches and late-night slices.

dish_highlights.review_text: A thick, airy Roman focaccia base with a crisp bottom crust, drenched in bubbling mozzarella, sharp aged cheddar, and a kick of creamy gorgonzola.
Vår vri på klassikeren Diavola bakt på deilig surdeig med klassisk tomatsaus, mozzarella, rødløk, fersk chilli, pepperoni, nduja og grillet.
Opplev en ordentlig Pepperoni-pizza bakt på surdeig med krydret tomatsaus, mozzarella, cheddar, rødløk og pepperoni. Toppet med digg-krydder.

name: Kuro Oslo
why_curated: Hidden on a quiet residential corner of Rathkes gate, Kuro blends Japanese minimalist design with Nordic specialty coffee precision. The cafe works with small-batch specialty roasters and Japanese tea growers, pouring precision hand brews alongside seasonal specialty milk concoctions. Its stripped-back aesthetic, quiet vinyl soundtrack, and thoughtful drink craft make it an insider retreat away from busy thoroughfares.

dish_highlights.review_text: A velvety espresso and micro-foamed milk drink spiced with real roasted pumpkin purée, warming cinnamon, nutmeg, and a touch of brown sugar.
Hand-whisked Japanese matcha served smooth with Kuro's house-made syrup.
Bright Nordic espresso pulled cold over tonic water and ice for crisp citrus clarity.

name: 175°C K-fried
why_curated: Located inside the bustling Mathallen food hall at Vulkan, 175°C K-fried is dedicated to perfecting Korean double-fried chicken cooked at the precise temperature in its name. The thin potato-starch batter shatters on first bite, keeping the chicken beneath tender and juicy before being hand-brushed with savory glazes. It is Oslo's definitive stop for authentic Seoul-style chimaek along the Akerselva river.

dish_highlights.review_text: Extraordinarily crunchy, double-fried golden chicken coated in a sticky-sweet fermented gochujang glaze, showered with toasted sesame seeds and crushed garlic.
Double fried crispy chicken wings serve with homemade ground chilli powder on the side.
220g Fresh chicken thighs cut into small pieces. Double fried crispy chicken boneless, serve with homemade ground chilli powder on the side.

name: Cocoa Café
why_curated: Situated overlooking Birkelunden park, Cocoa Café is Norway's original dedicated hot chocolate lounge, celebrating molten drinking chocolate crafted with single-origin beans and farm milk. The cozy vintage space invites visitors to choose cocoa percentages, warming spices, and mountain-high homemade toppings. It is a cherished Grünerløkka institution for warming hands after cold strolls through the neighborhood flea markets.

dish_highlights.review_text: Thick, glossy single-origin melted chocolate whisked with velvety steamed whole milk and crowned with airy homemade marshmallow cream.
Chilled velvety cocoa poured over ice with dark chocolate shavings and cream.
Moist spiced carrot cake topped with smooth cream cheese frosting.

name: Dirty Taco
why_curated: Anchoring the corner of Olaf Ryes plass in Grünerløkka, Dirty Taco shakes up the classic Mexican format with irreverent street-fusion tacos and loaded snack bowls. The kitchen blends slow-braised meats, spicy house sauces, and crispy additions onto warm pressed tortillas. Its energetic music and bustling terrace make it a go-to gathering point for park-goers and casual weekend drinks.

dish_highlights.review_text: Crisp flat-top griddled corn tortillas stuffed with slow-cooked shredded beef and melted cheese, served with a rich, spiced dipping broth.
Frityrstekt kylling vendt i søt og krydret koreansk saus. Vårløk, kimchi, chilisyltet agurk, dirty mayo og kimchi-ristede sesamfrø.
Marinert svinekam, hot spicy mayo, sriracha, syltet gulrot & reddik, koriander, ristet løk.

name: Em Oi!
why_curated: Operating out of a vibrant stall on historic Brugata, Em Oi! delivers fast-paced, deeply aromatic Vietnamese hawker classics to downtown commuters. Their simmer pots bubble with 12-hour spiced bone broths while phin drip filters press rich dark Robusta coffee sweetened with condensed milk. It serves as an essential pitstop for authentic street cooking that cuts through Oslo's chilly weather.

dish_highlights.review_text: Silky flat rice noodles bathed in a fragrant, 12-hour star-anise beef bone broth topped with thinly shaved sirloin, scallions, and fresh herbs.
Bittersweet dark Vietnamese robusta drip poured over an icy, velvety cloud of blended coconut cream and sweetened condensed milk.

name: Håndbakt Tøyen
why_curated: Håndbakt operates as a pioneering organic, plant-based sourdough bakery and café nestled on Kjølberggata in Tøyen. Working exclusively with sustainably farmed Nordic grains and natural wild yeast, their bakers craft sourdough loaves and laminated pastries that rival traditional butter bakeries. The light-flooded corner shop has become a morning focal point for neighborhood families, artists, and ethical food lovers.

dish_highlights.review_text: A rustic hand-twisted sourdough knot bursting with coarsely ground green cardamom, possessing a sticky caramelized base and tender layered crumb.
Long-fermented organic plant-based sourdough swirl laced with Ceylon cinnamon.
Soft organic sourdough bun topped with roasted pistachio cream and crushed nuts.

name: Mandi House restaurant Oslo بيت المندي، ،yemeni restaurant
why_curated: Situated in the heart of Tøyen, Mandi House introduces Oslo to the ancient culinary traditions of Yemen and the Arabian Peninsula. The kitchen centers on the slow-braising and charcoal-roasting of seasoned whole lamb and chicken over massive mounds of long-grain basmati spiced with dried lime, cardamom, and saffron. Served communally on wide silver platters with fiery tomato-coriander salsa, it is a warm, deeply hospitable feast for families and friends.

dish_highlights.review_text: Fall-apart tender braised lamb shoulder redolent with smoky whole spices, resting on a fragrant bed of golden basmati rice with a bright zahawig tomato-chili salsa.
Yemeni brød med banan, laks og bukkehornkløver.
Stekt laks i krydder med løk og ris laget på en spesiell måte.

name: Ochaya - The Matcha
why_curated: Tucked near Torggata, Ochaya is Oslo's dedicated Japanese tea bar, sourcing ceremonial and culinary grade green tea directly from historic estates in Uji, Kyoto. Behind the minimalist blonde-wood counter, each bowl of emerald matcha is whisked to order with a bamboo chasen before being layered into cold or steamed milk drinks. It serves as a calm sanctuary for tea purists and dessert lovers seeking genuine bittersweet Japanese flavors.

dish_highlights.review_text: Vibrant grassy Uji matcha layered over creamy milk and topped with rich, spiced caramelized Lotus cookie butter drizzle.
Bamboo-whisked ceremonial Uji Kyoto matcha balanced with velvety steamed or oat milk.
Layered vibrant mango puree topped with whisked ceremonial matcha and milk.

name: Zam Zam avd HASLE
why_curated: Stationed in the bustling residential hub of Hasle, Zam Zam has earned legendary status among locals for serving authentic American-style cheesesteaks and loaded street eats. Sizzling beef is griddled to order on the flat-top with sweet onions and molten cheese before being tucked into soft toasted bakery hoagies. Generous portions and punchy seasoning make it one of the city's top casual comfort food destinations.

dish_highlights.review_text: Thin-ribboned grilled beefsteak tossed with caramelized onions and peppers, blanketed in gooey melted cheese inside a warm, soft-toasted roll.
Marinert kylling grilles med paprika, løk og sopp, og serveres med salat, pommes frites og bearnaisesaus.
Fersk avokado moset med fersk sitron og havsalt. Toppet med frisk vinaigrette av grønn chili, syltet rødløk, lollo-salat, marinert kyllingfi.
